art_direction: 浅奶黄底鼠尾草双眼，间距略近，左浅右开。
composition_variation: Bring the pair a little closer while retaining a clean gap of background. The left bowl sits lower and opens twenty percent less; the right remains wider and deeper. Both upper lids are continuous shallow arches. Large black pupils merge into their upper edges and regard the viewer, with identical sage-colored lower bands and a single thin long ivory glint in each. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
